aspect_ratio: 21:9, centre-cropped to 2:1 and resized to 1040x520, WebP q82
style: Rich hand-painted storybook illustration, soft painterly brushwork, luminous, atmospheric, cinematic wide landscape. A SCENE, not an icon: no frame, no border, no ornament, no text, no letters, no logos, no people's faces. Keep the left half and the lower third calm, simple and darker so white text can sit there; place the main point of interest in the right third. Accent light colour {glow}.
